Jason buried the memory the only way he knew how: by assuming she had chosen to forget him. Now she’s back. After four years abroad, Roman Sionis’s daughter has finally returned to Gotham. Desperate to stay eligible, he needs a biology tutor—and the last person he expects to help him is his best friend Roy's younger sister. After an accidental drunk hook-up changes everything, they strike a deal: she'll tutor him, and he'll help her gain the experience she was lacking. But what starts as harmless practice soon turns into stolen moments, undeniable chemistry, and feelings neither of them planned for. With family secrets, broken trust, and the risk of losing the people they love most, they'll have to decide if some rules are worth breaking for a chance at forever.
